### Synthesis Overview

This PR is a focused documentation-only change that removes two stale references to the deleted `.opencode/tools/` directory and the retired "TypeScript wrappers" concept from `.opencode/agents/coder.md`. All three models independently confirm the substitutions are semantically correct, preserve intended guidance, and accurately reflect the Python-native tool architecture established by ADR 007. There is strong consensus that no residual `.opencode/tools/` or TypeScript references remain in the modified file, and no numbered lists were disturbed. The only divergence is GLM's broader scope expectation and a minor stylistic preference, both of which are outlier views against a 2-model majority.
